meta.title: eRFX Technical + RFQ project (RFQ stage): add a surrogate bid for Vendor A
gaps: Entering or asserting a bid reference, because place_surrogate_bid has no reference argument or reference assertion.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Entering or asserting a bid reference, because place_surrogate_bid has no reference argument or reference assertion.

steps.note: Open the prepared project's RFQ Participants tab, which is the required starting screen for this case.
Enter and submit the buyer's surrogate bid for Vendor A on the pricing stage.
Assert that the surrogate bid submission was accepted.
Open Master QCS and assert that Vendor A's bid is present in the comparison grid.
Verify the QCS grid contains one real vendor column for Vendor A.
Assert that the submitted RFQ bid is ranked according to its amount; with the prepared single-vendor state, it must be rank 1.
